# Export Decision 8: Accepted Direction

An export must be reproducible from the exact approved quote revisions after the
original browser session ends. Project-plus-quote identity is mandatory because
quote numbers repeat between projects. Currency and revision are not presentation
details that can be dropped when grouping records.

Test public reuse with two projects sharing quoteId and with a cold second process.
Exercise authorization failure and changed access on a later export. Single-project
row counts alone cannot establish reusable acceptance. No outside publication or
production data access is authorized by this direction.
